messages.subject: Re: Continuing FieldChain Research & Adaptive Sharding Follow-up
messages.snippet: Great catching up at CCNCPS 2026 in Dubai. Your presentation on Byzantine fault tolerance and adaptive sharding in FieldChain was very compelling. Let's arrange a follow-up sync to discuss joint research on multi-cluster consensus.
